what: Plan requires redirecting phantom probe stdout but does not forbid the unredirected inline pattern used in step-2-post-dispatch.sh
scenario_or_breakage: An implementer may source lib-phantom-probe.sh and call phantom_probe_with_warn 8-pre-ship without >&2 mirroring step-2-post-dispatch.sh. emit_kv writes PHANTOM_* lines to stdout when quiet mode is off, prepending KV lines before the ship pr JSON and breaking the Step 8+ single-object stdout contract
suggested_fix: In ### UPDATED: skills/implement/scripts/step-8-ship.sh add an explicit invariant: wrapper stdout is reserved exclusively for ship pr JSON; phantom output must use a subprocess with >&2 (or 1>&2); do not inline unredirected phantom_probe_with_warn
